articles.title: D-topia review – cosy sci-fi mystery takes aim at AI
articles.que_paso: The game D-topia, developed by Marumittu Games, is set in a future where AI has taken over and is responsible for ensuring the happiness of humanity. The game follows a young Facilitator as they tend to the city's bots and human residents, while also exploring the limitations of a utilitarian society. The game's narrative is a commentary on the potential downsides of a highly optimized and convenient future.
datos: The game is available on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2

The game's story is set in a planet that is not Earth

The game features a cast of characters, including Tot and Eebie, who have their own struggles and desires in the optimized society
articles.conclusion: The game's thoughtful and subtle approach to exploring the implications of a highly optimized society makes it a notable commentary on the potential risks and downsides of relying heavily on AI. The game's ability to balance its philosophical concerns with engaging gameplay makes it a compelling experience for players.

articles.title: Multiverse Computing y OpenChip, las dos grandes desconocidas de la tecnología española en la carrera de la IA
articles.que_paso: La carrera de la inteligencia artificial en España cuenta con dos startups destacadas, Multiverse Computing y OpenChip, que están trabajando en la creación de tecnologías para reducir el consumo energético de la inteligencia artificial. Estas empresas han recibido apoyo del Gobierno y están involucradas en la iniciativa de la gigafactoría europea para el desarrollo de modelos de frontera. La startup Multiverse Computing está directamente involucrada en el proceso de la gigafactoría española, mientras que OpenChip podría estarlo pronto.
datos: Multiverse Computing fue fundada en San Sebastián en 2019
OpenChip fue fundada en Barcelona en 2021

articles.title: ¿A qué temperatura deja de ser efectivo un ventilador?
articles.que_paso: El ventilador eléctrico, inventado por Schuyler Skaats Wheeler en 1882, se ha convertido en un elemento común en los hogares durante el verano. Sin embargo, su eficacia para refrescar depende de factores como la temperatura y la humedad del ambiente. La investigación ha demostrado que el ventilador solo es efectivo si el cuerpo puede sudar y la humedad del aire no es demasiado alta.
datos: 35 °C es la temperatura aproximada a la que el aire caliente puede empezar a calentar la piel en lugar de enfriarla
39 °C es el umbral de temperatura para adultos jóvenes y sanos por encima del cual el ventilador deja de ser beneficioso
38 °C es el umbral de temperatura para adultos mayores sanos por encima del cual el ventilador deja de ser beneficioso
96,6% de los días calurosos del mes serían adecuados para el uso de ventiladores en 108 ciudades del mundo para adultos jóvenes
20% de humedad relativa es considerada muy baja y permite una mayor eficacia del ventilador
articles.conclusion: La eficacia del ventilador depende de factores como la temperatura y la humedad del ambiente, por lo que es importante considerar estos factores al decidir si usar un ventilador. Un umbral de temperatura más alto que 35 °C puede ser beneficioso para la mayoría de las personas, siempre y cuando se tenga en cuenta la humedad del aire.

articles.title: New York Becomes First State to Ban AI Data Centers
articles.que_paso: New York governor Kathy Hochul has announced a one-year ban on new AI data center construction, amid growing concerns over pollution, water usage, and electricity prices. The ban is part of a larger effort to regulate the tech industry and address the impact of AI data centers on the environment. This move comes as lawmakers face pressure from both the tech industry and constituents who are concerned about the effects of these facilities.
datos: 50 megawatts: the minimum electrical capacity of AI data centers affected by the ban
June 4: the date the New York State Senate passed a bill to ban data centers of 20 megawatts or more for up to a year
30 megawatts: the increase in the maximum allowable size of data centers under Hochul's executive order compared to the Senate bill
2026: the year in which the midterm elections will take place, and the Democratic party is seeking to regain voter confidence
20 megawatts: the original threshold for data centers proposed in the New York State Senate bill
articles.conclusion: The ban on AI data centers in New York highlights the growing tension between the tech industry and concerns over environmental impact, and may set a precedent for other states to follow. This move also reflects the ongoing debate within the Democratic party over how to regulate the tech industry and balance economic growth with environmental and social concerns.

articles.title: New York bans data center construction for a year, rattling AI industry
articles.que_paso: New York's decision to impose a moratorium on data center construction is a response to growing concerns about the environmental and social impacts of these facilities. The state's move is part of a larger trend of increased scrutiny of data center development across the US. Governor Kathy Hochul's announcement comes after researchers found that over $130 billion in data center projects have been blocked or delayed by protests this year.

This move highlights the need for companies to prioritize responsible and sustainable development practices to mitigate the risks associated with data center construction.

articles.title: Synthetic Sincerity review – Marc Isaacs’ AI interrogation grapples with identity and existence
articles.que_paso: The film Synthetic Sincerity, directed by Marc Isaacs, explores the concept of artificial intelligence and its potential to create human-like figures on screen. The story involves a fictional AI research lab at the University of Southern England, where researchers, including Lebanese film-maker Lynn El Safah, work on training software using characters from Isaacs' previous documentaries. The project aims to create an AI version of Ablikim Rahman, a real exiled Uyghur man who runs a restaurant in London.
datos: Marc Isaacs is the director of the film Synthetic Sincerity
The film features a fictional AI research lab at the University of Southern England
Lynn El Safah is a Lebanese independent film-maker who appears in the film
Ilinca Manolache's face was digitally modelled to create an AI avatar
Ablikim Rahman is a real exiled Uyghur man who runs a restaurant in London
The University of Southern England is a fictional institution
articles.conclusion: The film's exploration of artificial intelligence and identity raises important questions about the potential of AI to replicate human emotions and experiences, but its execution falls short due to its shallow and confusing narrative. The project's implications for the use of AI in therapeutic settings are also unclear, leaving the viewer with more questions than answers.

articles.title: Es una de las mejores películas de ciencia ficción de los 90, una gran compañía para el calor y está en Prime Video
articles.que_paso: La película 'Stargate. Puerta a las estrellas' fue inicialmente rechazada por varios estudios de Hollywood debido a la percepción de que la ciencia ficción no era popular en ese momento. Sin embargo, Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer aceptó distribuirla y la productora Carolco Pictures financió el rodaje. La película se convirtió en un éxito comercial y dio lugar a una franquicia que incluye series de televisión.
datos: 32 años después de su estreno, la franquicia de 'Stargate' incluye una serie con cientos de episodios

La serie 'Stargate SG-1' duró diez temporadas

articles.conclusion: La historia de 'Stargate' muestra cómo una película inicialmente rechazada puede convertirse en un éxito comercial y dar lugar a una franquicia exitosa, lo que destaca la importancia de perseverar en la industria del entretenimiento. Su disponibilidad en Prime Video la convierte en una excelente opción para el verano.

This development has raised questions about the company's true goals and its potential involvement with the federal government.
